story:
SETS (make each one a cast member of kind "set" and give every shot the set of the place it shows):
1. Brighton seafront: the pier and its shingle beach by the sea (kit place: beach); morning wind, afternoon, golden dusk
2. Grandfather's kitchen with a wooden table and a window (kit place: kitchen); morning light

KEY OBJECT (the owner's notes — draw it exactly so): Maya's red diamond kite: a red sail on a cross of thin bamboo sticks, a tail of small bows, flown on a string. States in order: intact (smooth taut sail) → torn (a jagged hole with a flap of sail hanging down and the sky showing through it) → patched (a white cloth patch over the hole with visible stitches) → starred (the same patch with a big gold star painted on it).

On a windy autumn morning in Brighton, eight-year-old Maya flies her red kite above the pier. A gust slams it into the pier railings, and the red sail tears from corner to corner. Maya runs home along the seafront, the broken kite hugged to her chest. Her grandfather, who mended sails when he was young, looks up from his newspaper. At the kitchen table he lays the kite flat and threads a needle with sailcloth thread. Stitch by stitch, he shows Maya how a sailor's seam holds against the wind. Maya paints a small gold star over the patch, so the kite will remember. In the afternoon they walk back to the beach together, the kite under Grandfather's arm. Maya runs into the wind, and the kite climbs higher than ever over the waves. She hands the string to her grandfather, and he laughs like a boy. At golden dusk they walk home along the sand, the mended kite on Maya's shoulder.

bible.title: The Mended Kite
bible.logline: A gust tears a child's kite; a grandfather's sailor's seam and a gold star mend it for a soaring reunion at dusk.

cast.name: Maya
cast.look: Eight-year-old girl with short chestnut hair, wearing a yellow raincoat over a striped tee, blue jeans, red wellies. Signature detail: a small silver kite charm on her zipper.

cast.name: Grandfather
cast.look: Elderly man with white hair and beard, wearing a navy cardigan over a cream shirt, brown trousers, leather slippers. Signature detail: a brass thimble on a chain around his neck.

cast.name: Maya's red diamond kite
cast.look: Red diamond kite: red sail on thin bamboo cross, small bow tail, string. States: intact (smooth taut sail), torn (jagged hole corner to corner with flap hanging, sky visible), patched (white cloth patch with visible stitches), starred (same patch with big gold star painted).

cast.name: Brighton seafront
cast.look: Brighton pier extending over shingle beach, wooden railings, sea horizon. Morning wind with gentle waves, afternoon bright, golden dusk glow.

cast.name: Grandfather's kitchen
cast.look: Cozy vintage kitchen with wooden table, window with lace curtains, morning light streaming in. Kettle, jars, newspaper on table.

shots.description: Dawn light paints the Brighton pier gold; Maya stands on the shingle beach, holding the string of her red kite which billows high above the railings.
shots.dialogue: On a windy autumn morning in Brighton, eight-year-old Maya flies her red kite above the pier.

shots.description: A sudden gust slams the kite into the wooden railings; the red sail rips from corner to corner, a flap fluttering in the wind.
shots.dialogue: A gust slams it into the pier railings, and the red sail tears from corner to corner.

shots.description: Maya sprints along the wet shingle, the torn kite clutched to her chest, sea spray catching the morning light.
shots.dialogue: Maya runs home along the seafront, the broken kite hugged to her chest.

shots.description: Morning light streams through lace curtains onto the wooden table; Grandfather lowers his newspaper, eyes widening as Maya bursts in.
shots.dialogue: Her grandfather, who mended sails when he was young, looks up from his newspaper.

shots.description: On the table the kite lies flat, its torn sail exposed; Grandfather threads a needle with sailcloth thread, poised to stitch.
shots.dialogue: At the kitchen table he lays the kite flat and threads a needle with sailcloth thread.

shots.description: Grandfather demonstrates a sailor's seam, needle pulling the white patch tight; Maya watches intently from the side.
shots.dialogue: Stitch by stitch, he shows Maya how a sailor's seam holds against the wind.

shots.description: Maya dabs a brush in gold paint, pressing a bright star onto the fresh patch; the star glints in the window light.
shots.dialogue: Maya paints a small gold star over the patch, so the kite will remember.

shots.description: Afternoon sun brightens the sea; Grandfather and Maya stroll side by side along the sand, the starred kite tucked under his arm.
shots.dialogue: In the afternoon they walk back to the beach together, the kite under Grandfather's arm.

shots.description: Maya darts into the wind, the kite surging higher than ever, its red diamond cutting the bright sky.
shots.dialogue: Maya runs into the wind, and the kite climbs higher than ever over the waves.

shots.description: Maya extends the string toward Grandfather; he catches it, head thrown back in boyish laughter, the kite dancing above.
shots.dialogue: She hands the string to her grandfather, and he laughs like a boy.

shots.description: Golden dusk bathes the beach; Maya and Grandfather walk home along the sand, the mended kite resting on Maya's shoulder, its gold star winking.
shots.dialogue: At golden dusk they walk home along the sand, the mended kite on Maya's shoulder.
